# Roshan AI

> Roshan AI builds sovereign clinical AI models that reason in medical terms: interpretable by architecture, with human-in-the-loop auditability. Its flagship, ShifaMind, predicts ICD-10 codes from clinical notes, and every code's score is an exact sum of named clinical concepts. Access is by request.

Roshan AI LLC is based in Arizona, USA. Contact: mohammed@roshan-ai.com.

## Products

- [ShifaMind](https://roshan-ai.com/products/shifamind): concept-grounded ICD-10 coding. 99.2 micro-AUROC and 96.7 macro-AUROC on the full 7,940-code MIMIC-IV benchmark; every prediction traced to named clinical concepts and the words behind them.
- [Nabz](https://roshan-ai.com/products/nabz): research models for bedside-monitor signals.
- [NabzGraph](https://roshan-ai.com/products/nabz/graph): feedback-robust patient knowledge graphs (preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33248).
- [NabzSentry](https://roshan-ai.com/products/nabz/sentry): certified three-way triage of ICU ventricular-tachycardia (VT) alarms (preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.12365).
- [All products](https://roshan-ai.com/products)

## Platform and developers

- [Platform](https://roshan-ai.com/platform): the shared clinical reasoning stack behind every Roshan AI model.
- [Developers](https://roshan-ai.com/developers): the ShifaMind API (access by request).
